records.title: National Institute of Locomotor Disabilities, Kolkata
details: (a) The proposal for the construction of a new building for the National Institute for Locomotor Disabilities (NILD), Kolkata, after obtaining in-principle of the department, approval is currently under consideration at Detailed Project Report (DPR) stage. records.title: Structural Issues at Kavi Subhash Metro Station
details:
Balance work from Beleghata to Dum Dum Airport (22.2 km) has been taken up.
Kavi Subhash metro station of Blue Line i.e. Dakshineshwar- Kavi Subhash corridor was constructed during 2008 - 2010 and commissioned in 2010. Due to structural issues, in the up platform of this Kavi Subhash metro station, the station has been closed for passenger services in July 2025. The rehabilitation work of this platform has been taken up.

details:

records.title: PROGRESS OF EXPRESSWAYS IN WEST BENGAL
details:
The Hon"ble Minister stated that Mr. Chairman, the answer has been given. The DPR work for these four national highways is yet to be completed. It takes time for alignment and some clearances from the state government. Along with this, the work of DPR is also going on. After the completion of the DPR work, its detailed projections will be given to you.
[Original text: माननीय मंत्री जी ने कहा कि सभापति महोदय, इसका उत्तर दिया गया है। ये जो चारों राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग है, ये अभी डीपीआर का काम समाप्त होने पर हैं। इसमें alignment आने और स्टेट गवर्नमेंट से कुछ clearances आने में समय लगता है। इसके साथ-साथ डीपीआर का बी काम चल रहा है। डीपीआर का काम समाप्त होने के बाद इसकी जो detailed projections है, वह आपको दे दी जाएगी.]
